mainText: <speak><voice name="Justin">Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 78 degrees with clear skies at Harriet Park and a bright full moon glowing above.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joanna">City officials are working on several projects including a new pickleball court and a large addition at 201 South Main Street, which will be discussed by the Plan Commission on August 3. Meanwhile, the Senior Center is inviting residents to enjoy the outdoors with their tri-shaw bike program, though a signed liability waiver is required to participate.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Joey">There is plenty to do in town with trivia tonight at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the downtown farmer's market or join the trivia fun at The Bogey Factory.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Matthew">In our weekly police report, on July 26, officers responded to a hit and run crash near West Verona Avenue where an 83-year-old driver was cited for an improper left turn.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Kendra">You can cool down with the Georgia Peach flavor of the day! Culver's is currently closed, but they will open their doors at 10 AM tomorrow to serve you.</voice></speak>
